## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: broad sector breadth and strong Financials/Industrials (1W leadership) offset by narrow leadership concentrated in semiconductors (Top 5 all Technology), and major divergences among large-cap software names — supports a neutral, wait-for-confirmation stance.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Financials lead: JPM (1W: +5.60% | 1M: +8.03%) ABOVE TREND, X omitted for brevity; Industrials strong: CAT (1W: +7.77% | 1M: +9.82%) ABOVE TREND, ETN (1W: +9.54% | 1M: +10.91%) ABOVE TREND; Technology showing semiconductor strength: INTC (1W: +28.50% | 1M: +31.94%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +16.55% | 1M: +20.22%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy lagging: XOM (1W: -3.57% | 1M: +4.66%) CORRECTION, PSX (1W: -8.30% | 1M: -0.88%) BELOW TREND; Communication showing pockets of weakness: T (1W: -5.19% | 1M: -3.14%) BELOW TREND; Consumer Discretionary mixed with TSLA (1W: -9.35% | 1M: -13.43%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +28.50% | 1M: +31.94%) ABOVE TREND; LRCX (1W: +16.55% | 1M: +20.22%) ABOVE TREND; AVGO (1W: +13.21% | 1M: +3.82%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +12.57% | 1M: +16.44%) ABOVE TREND; AMAT (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +15.01%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (Top 5 = 5/5 Technology) — concentration risk.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: INTU (1W: -14.81% | 1M: -20.08%) BELOW TREND; NOW (1W: -13.68% | 1M: -22.98%) BELOW TREND; PLTR (1W: -10.92% | 1M: -13.66%) BELOW TREND; TSLA (1W: -9.35% | 1M: -13.43%) BELOW TREND; PSX (1W: -8.30% | 1M: -0.88%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in software and select consumer names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W momentum: INTC (1W: +28.50% | 1M: +31.94%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +16.55% | 1M: +20.22%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +8.70%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +10.96% | 1M: +9.01%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence flagged: multiple megacaps (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, META, V, MA) show 1W vs 1M mismatches → MAJOR DIVERGENCE, watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed — semiconductors leading while many software names lag. Semis: INTC (1W: +28.50% | 1M: +31.94%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +16.55% | 1M: +20.22%) ABOVE TREND; Software & platforms struggling: CRM (1W: -8.03% | 1M: -12.12%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -13.68% | 1M: -22.98%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Positive overall but internally rotating toward hardware/semis.

8. Financials Outlook?
Healthy and leadership-confirmed. JPM (1W: +5.60% | 1M: +8.03%) ABOVE TREND and the sector 1W outperformance (Financials 1W: +5.32%) signals cyclical participation. Style: Financials favored within the current neutral regime.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed defensive characteristics with dispersion. UNH (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +8.70%) ABOVE TREND while JNJ (1W: -1.15% | 1M: -0.98%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: +0.07% | 1M: -4.61%) RECOVERY — selective idea set; sector breadth modestly positive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor repositioning toward Financials and Industrials given broad 1W strength, reduce exposure to lagging software/high multiple names showing BELOW TREND, and monitor narrow semiconductor leadership for fading risk. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; risk manage positions given MAJOR DIVERGENCE among megacaps.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +28.50% | 1M: +31.94%) ABOVE TREND — watch follow-through; LRCX (1W: +16.55% | 1M: +20.22%) ABOVE TREND; AMZN (1W: +10.96% | 1M: +9.01%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: INTU (1W: -14.81% | 1M: -20.08%) BELOW TREND; NOW (1W: -13.68% | 1M: -22.98%) BELOW TREND; TSLA (1W: -9.35% | 1M: -13.43%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Financials (1W: +5.32%) and Industrials (1W: +4.71%) — monitor earnings/flows. BEARISH: Energy (1W: -3.03%) and select Communication names — watch earnings and sentiment headlines.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch semiconductor follow-through on this week's breakout range for INTC and LRCX as confirmation of the narrow leadership; monitor INTU/NOW for breakdown confirmation under recent lows; watch JPM and CAT continuation above this week's gains as a sign of broader risk tolerance.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
BA (+55): BA (1W: +6.15% | 1M: +1.06%) ABOVE TREND — defense contract headlines confirming price strength. GE (+80): headline-driven optimism; monitor for confirmation (price not shown here). BA sentiment confirmed by price; other bullish names need follow-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
PSX (-60): PSX (1W: -8.30% | 1M: -0.88%) BELOW TREND — derivatives loss headline confirming downside. PLTR (-50): PLTR (1W: -10.92% | 1M: -13.66%) BELOW TREND — negative news confirmed. TSLA (-50): TSLA (1W: -9.35% | 1M: -13.43%) BELOW TREND — earnings/delivery miss and price confirming risk. HD (-55): HD (1W: +3.04% | 1M: -4.28%) RECOVERY — negative sentiment diverging from short-term price bounce, monitor.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership. INTC (1W: +28.50% | 1M: +31.94%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +5.60% | 1M: +8.03%) ABOVE TREND and CAT (1W: +7.77% | 1M: +9.82%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: narrow semiconductor leadership and MAJOR DIVERGENCE among megacaps (AAPL/MSFT/NVDA/META) plus negative sentiment in select names (PSX, PLTR, TSLA) — watch for trend confirmation.
